data.reason: Review round 2 returns on F1 (medium): a later finding joins the first claim-only match before a match on both texts, so by_severity can drop a high finding. F2: the regression is rerun after the Outcome is final. F3 accepted again as the status mirror.

findings.claim: finding_identities joins a later finding to the first earlier finding that matches on claim, before trying the one that matches on both claim and failure scenario, so a carried-forward finding can be counted under the wrong identity and kpi.findings' by_severity drops a finding's severity.
findings.failure_scenario: Record 1 holds F1 (high, harness/a.py:1, claim 'Same claim', scenario 'Scenario A') and F2 (low, harness/a.py:5, claim 'Same claim', scenario 'Scenario B'); record 2 carries F2 word for word. F2's copy joins F1 through the claim, the scenario join to F2 is then refused because both identities hold record 1, and kpi.findings returns by_severity {'low': 2} instead of {'high': 1, 'low': 1}. The old (id, claim, file) key returned the right figure for this input.
findings.rule_candidate: none: an order-dependent choice in a union-find join that only a test fixture can expose

findings.claim: The tree changed after regression record 24, most likely only the Outcome edit that cites records 24 and 25, so no full regression run is recorded against the reviewed tree.
findings.failure_scenario: If anything besides the ticket file changed between record 24 and triage 27, the 1573-test green no longer covers the tree that will be delivered.
findings.rule_candidate: none: an ordering of the procedure, which the triage's fingerprint check already reports

findings.claim: The status-row edit is named by no slice or changes entry, so slice_files fails again; this repeats round 1's F3, which was accepted as the procedure's status mirror.
findings.failure_scenario: The deterministic triage keeps sending this ticket to full depth because of a status-mirror line the procedure requires.
findings.rule_candidate: none: the status mirror is required by the procedure
